title: Power Rangers Unlimited #5
desc:
The Unlimited Team must stop the theft of the legendary Sabertooth Tiger Zord!

Twenty-five years in the future, in the heart of Mexico's Lacandon Jungle, a temple awaits those worthy to pass its trials...the sacred sanctuary of the Sabertooth Tiger Zord!

But a villain is on the scene with a powerful weapon, and they've got their eye on the Zord for themselves.

Trini has two of her best on the move: TJ Johnson (Red Turbo Ranger) and Taylor Earhardt (Yellow Wild Force Ranger). But while it's meant to be a reconnaissance job, the duo instead finds themselves in deep trouble—can they trust the arrival of a mind-bending mystery hero to save them and the mission at large?
